chunks: And ʿAlī عليه السلام was asked about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Glorious:
“And upon Allah let the reliant rely.”

key_terms.الزَّارِعُونَ: the farmers, identified here as exemplifying reliance upon Allah
key_terms.اللَّهِ: Allah, the One upon whom reliance is placed
key_terms.الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ: those who practice tawakkul, relying upon Allah
key_terms.فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ: let them rely and place their trust
key_terms.قَوْلِ: the statement or saying being interpreted

ai.seo_question: Who are the ones meant by “those who rely upon Allah” in this verse?
ai.summary: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام explains this Qur'anic phrase by identifying those who most clearly embody tawakkul as the farmers. Their work depends on effort joined with reliance upon Allah for growth, provision, and outcome.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3916 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) was asked about the saying of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious:
"And upon Allah (swt) let the reliant rely" (Surah Ibrahim 14:12).
Imam (as) said: "It refers to the farmers."
